message: No detected untrusted source handling: All datasets are loaded from local files or sklearn built-ins; no remote fetching is present, so no integrity checks or authentication are needed or implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs only standard scaling and k-fold splitting with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads and saves models (via trainer.train/evaluate and utils.make_model_dir) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision applied to any loaded model weights or serialized artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label ranges, or detects anomalous label distributions before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly analysis are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While KFold splitting separates train and test indices, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no independent held-out set enforced separately from cross-validation, and no protection against metric manipulation or leakage between folds.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads datasets and passes arrays directly to models without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks are applied to model outputs before they are returned or logged in the inference/evaluation path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses regression models on tabular data, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
